hints.title: Prioritize Minimum Weights
hints.text: To maximize the total count of items within a fixed capacity limit, always pick items with smallest individual weights first.

hints.title: Sort in Ascending Order
hints.text: Sorting the weight list lets you process items sequentially from lightest to heaviest.

hints.title: Accumulate until Limit Exceeded
hints.text: Keep adding items to your running weight sum while the total does not exceed 5000 units.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subsets requires 2^N combinations, which is infeasible.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the array enables greedy selection in linear time with minimal auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize this as an unweighted knapsack variant where greedy choice is optimal.
complexity.notes: Total allowed capacity is fixed at 5000 units.
